name: attachment-filename-index
description: Offline CLI to index attachment and Drive filenames into structured checklists

scripts.test:fixtures:dir: npm run build && node dist/index.js --dir fixtures/sample-files --output test-out-dir && echo 'Directory scan test completed successfully'
scripts.test:fixtures:list: npm run build && node dist/index.js --files fixtures/sample-filenames.txt --output test-out-list && echo 'Filename list test completed successfully'
scripts.test:fixtures:subjects: npm run build && node dist/index.js --files fixtures/sample-filenames.txt --subjects fixtures/sample-subjects.csv --output test-out-subjects && echo 'Subject matching test completed successfully'
